summary: Perry County, Alabama lookout on state forest land; a four-legged steel tower with cabin, NHLR-registered January 2026. No build date or staffing record found.

facts.design: Four-legged steel structure with an observation cabin (1971 survey description); state design number AL 141
facts.status_note: Nothing read says it has moved or come down; the most recent source is the January 2026 Register entry

access.note: Approach by dirt road through a locked gate, per 1971 survey directions; current access rules not found

resolved_conflicts.explanation: A 1971 survey text says the Alabama State Forest Service owned the tower; the Register names the Alabama Forestry Commission as administrator. The story uses the Register's current name.
The Register lists US 1801, AL 86 and gives AL 141 as the state design number; a blog calls the tower Registry # 141. The story follows the Register.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: no build date, height, staffing or fire history in any source read. The Register page has no visit reports. The access level is inferred from 1971 survey directions (locked gate) and should be checked before publishing. The blog's Registry # 141 conflicts with the Register's AL 86.
